exposure: continuous positive airway pressure support with oxygen >50%
time to achieve full feeds >10 days
cohort: Outborn and inborn babies eligible for ROP screening at a sick newborn care unit (SNCU) located at high altitude in North India.
finding: Birth weight <1500g, gestational age <32 weeks, oxygen >48h, clinical sepsis, total SNCU stay >14 days, continuous positive airway pressure support with oxygen >50%, and >10 days to achieve full feeds were associated with severe ROP, while caffeine treatment for apnea and kangaroo mother care reduced ROP.
gest_age: Average gestational age was 34 weeks, with sight-threatening ROP present in varying percentages across different gestational age groups (<28+6 weeks, 29-30+6 weeks, 31-33+6 weeks, >34 weeks).
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 1803.87g, with two babies with Type 1 ROP weighing >2kg.
